evidence.title: Visual Journal – Branding, Editorial and Graphic Design

name: Visual Journal
summary: Blog curating branding, editorial and graphic design projects from studios around the world.
description: A personal blog by art director Alessandro Scarpellini that showcases branding, editorial and graphic design work. Each post presents one project with images and the studio credits; designers and studios can submit case studies for editorial review.
contains: curated branding, editorial and graphic design project posts
each project credits its studio (e.g. Ascent by George&Harrison)
case-study submissions accepted from designers and studios
